senses.sense_definition: A movement in the arts, architecture, and literature during the 20th century that broke away from traditional styles.

examples.text: The exhibition explored how <w>modernism</w> changed the way architects designed buildings in the early twentieth century.
Many critics argue that <w>modernism</w> was a reaction against the rigid structures of the Victorian era.

senses.sense_definition: Contemporary ideas, thoughts, or practices that reflect current times.

examples.text: The professor discussed how <w>modernism</w> influences the way we approach social issues today.
Some people reject <w>modernism</w> in favor of returning to older, more traditional ways of living.

senses.sense_definition: Any quality or feature that is characteristic of the current era or modernity.

examples.text: The design of the new office building is a clear example of <w>modernism</w> in urban planning.
He believes that the rapid pace of technology is the defining <w>modernism</w> of our age.

senses.sense_definition: A 20th-century religious movement that attempted to align Roman Catholic teachings with modern scientific and philosophical thought.

examples.text: The church authorities officially condemned <w>modernism</w> as a threat to established religious dogma.
The historical debate over <w>modernism</w> remains a significant topic in theological studies.
